text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you fully prepared?!

Seeking the Pearl suddenly barged into the 
trainer's office.
choice_data_list:
Preparations? What races do we have coming 
up—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Nooo!! You're such a forgetful one, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"A promise! We made a promise, right? That 
I'd go polish myself all over to deliver 
brilliance to the whole world!!"
choice_data_list: Ah, pretty sure it was a hot spring...!

text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, Seeking the Pearl 
had mentioned it before, so I had 
thoroughly researched the spring water 
quality and the ryokan's meals."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Now, time to prepare for the European 
G1s! Let's get in shape so we don't bring 
shame to the Pearl Family!!

Following Seeking the Pearl's ringing 
laughter, we headed toward the inn—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Phew! It's all nice and shiny! Trainer, 
haven't you turned out quite well-groomed 
yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. It seems your fatigue has melted 
away. Indeed, coming here with you at this 
exact timing was the best choice.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To reach this point, you must have 
overcome countless obstacles, just like I 
have.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
However, we both believed in our dreams. 
We held a fierce faith in our own wishes, 
believing they would surely come true.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Continuing to believe in something is by 
no means an easy task.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many 'beautiful' words you 
dress it up with, dreams aren't all 
sweetness and light, after all.

Seeking the Pearl gazes at the night sky 
through the window. Reflected in her eyes 
were the countless races and obstacles 
that had stood in her path.

Yet there was no agony in it— only an 
absolute, dazzling radiance...
choice_data_list: Even so, we made it through.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And our future, our wishes... will 
continue on and on.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No matter how long it takes, no matter how 
huge the wall. ...Trainer. With you and me 
together, no problem!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Because we believe in each other!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"We won't betray each other's trust. 
...Right?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! What a nice response!! That's my 
Trainer for you!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"We have nothing to fear now! Before this 
brilliance, the world will surely be 
saved!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Inn Staff
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Your meal is ready. May I bring 
it to your room?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good! Nice timing! Trainer, you've already 
researched the menu, haven't you!?
choice_data_list: I looked up all the origins too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! Good job!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's savor every single bite! May the 
flavors, the nutrition, and the cook's 
devotion all dwell within our bodies to 
become our light!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, Chef!! Serve us the finest dinner 
worthy of our presence!!

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Seeking the Pearl...
